definition.note: RSV four-recipe mixture (fixed 2026-10-14 before its score was seen): Ball_c0w512 (Ba_ll: width-512 direct-quantile MLP, neighbouring-state exchange, all actual archived reports, log-loss 0.75, calendar features off), A4c0 (A4: width-192 sampled MLP with corrected histories, Kinsa, log-loss 1, calendar off), A4i (A4 with all six admission/ED input histories) and Bw (B_width256 with all six input histories); Ball_c0w512 also uses all six. Trained on 2022-23 through 2025-26 (no held-out season), seeds 42-51 per recipe, on panel-rsv.npz: NHSN RSV admissions before 2024-11-02 treated as unobserved (voluntary reporting), so admission labels start November 2024; RSV ED from October 2022. Training admission/ED histories made preliminary with artificial errors from the prescribed 2025-26 RSV reporting process. Labels: latest finalized future RSV admissions and ED (September 2026 panel). Equal weight per recipe and per seed; predictive distributions mixed. Selected by tree search rsv-tree-20261013 (experiments/rsv-tree-20261013/protocol.json): held-out states/DC log-admission WIS 0.3105 on artificial preliminary inputs, 0.3114 replayed on archived reports (2024-25, 2025-26). Correction strength 0.5: the saved trees' log-correction of the two newest reported weeks is multiplied by 0.5 at issuance (no retraining; release rsv-four-20261014).

assumptions: Descriptive forecast comparison, not accuracy scoring.
Latest target values at the pinned Hub commit, not reconstructed issuance-time truth.
No history dated after reference minus seven days is shown as current observations.
Prior season aligned by CDC week; unmatched week 53 omitted, no value rescaling.
Peer bands weight each available model median equally; local candidates are excluded.
Partial peer coverage is retained; no missing forecasts or history are imputed.
Training details are copied only from matching local export metadata; peer training is not inferred.
